Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `68593d46d88dbd3843b1332bd5eb02124fb0a763`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #20943 (body and all 10 comments: the seat analysis `5919778230`, ruling D `5921156712`, claim `5921298734`, dev reports `5922668750` / `5922922632` / `5923452954` / `5924841117`, seat rulings `5922695050` / `5924874583`, landing record `5924625065`); PR #20998 (merged `5d5e679873`); PR #21071 body and file list; `git diff origin/main...68593d46d8` (3 files, +18 / -11; the merge base is `6073bb96b8` and no commit on `main` since touches the three paths, so the three-dot diff IS the net diff); the tree at the head via `git show` / `git grep`; the head's check-runs, read last.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept set and public surface.** The diff touches `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**` and `docs/qa/**` only; no schema, no runtime, no generated artifact. It changes no accept set. Every public-surface change it implies is text, judged sentence by sentence below.

**A. ADR-0021 note (D1, after the RLS paragraph) — every sentence tested against the tree at the head, verdict RIGHT.**
- "carries 'zero raw SQL / zero raw expressions' to the members of an analytics cube; it shipped in #20998" — right: ruling D `5921156712` retires raw expressions in a cube member's `sql`; #20998 merged as `5d5e679873`. "members" is the precise word: the cube-level `CubeSchema.sql` is NOT narrowed (the dev's out-of-scope finding on `5922668750`), and the note does not claim it is.
- "the `sql` of a cube measure (MetricSchema) and of a cube dimension (DimensionSchema) is a column reference: a field of the cube's object, a relationship path ending in one, or `'*'` (CUBE_MEMBER_SQL)" — right: `analytics.zod.ts:240` `CUBE_MEMBER_SQL = /^(?:\*|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*)$/`, applied as `.regex()` at `MetricSchema.sql` (`:330`) and `DimensionSchema.sql` (`:394`). `'*'` is admitted on both members (the dev's Q2, ruled A on `5922695050`), and the note says `'*'` without the ruling's "for a count" qualifier, which is the tree's truth, not an over-statement. The three symbol anchors name symbols that exist at the head (`export const MetricSchema` `:282`, `export const DimensionSchema` `:367`, `const CUBE_MEMBER_SQL` `:240`); `Lint & Repo Gates` (success) carries `check:adr-symbol-anchors` and `check:adr-links`.
- "A SQL expression there (a CASE, an aggregate, a ratio of aggregates) is refused at parse" — right: the regex admits no space, parenthesis, operator or quote; refusal is `invalid_format` with the prescription at every parse door (`defineCube`, `StackSchema.parse`). True on `main` now.
- "A measure's refusal names the D1 form: a measure with its own `filter` for a conditional count or sum, and `derived: { op, of }` over named measures for a ratio, sum, difference or product" — right, verbatim against `CUBE_METRIC_SQL_EXPRESSION_REFUSED` (`:248-258`); `dataset.zod.ts` carries measure `filter` (`:196`) and `DerivedMeasureOp = ['ratio','sum','difference','product']` (`:136`).
- "A dimension's refusal says to keep a computed bucket as a field of the object" — right against `CUBE_DIMENSION_SQL_EXPRESSION_REFUSED` (`:260-265`).
- More or less than ruling D: the note says nothing MORE than the ruling. It says LESS in one respect: it omits the ruling's interim and services follow-up (the gate's stand-down branch at `analytics-service.ts:411` still exists at the head, unreachable for any parsed cube, deletion owed to #20965). The "Governed half" bullet of `5921156712` asks only for "a dated note under its decision naming the spec symbol", which this is; the omission is not a defect of the contract record, noted here so the reader of the ADR does not take the runtime branch as gone.
- ADR-0021 elsewhere: read whole at the head. `:16` (dated Correction), `:118` (the principle, now enforced one layer lower), `:123` ("expressible four ways", decision-time context), `:358-364` (Finding 2, dated 2026-05-31, about joins and RLS) — none is made false by this retirement. `:140-143` and `:381` (D-A: "the author-facing Cube DSL is retired/absorbed") were already at odds with an authored `analytics_cube` before ruling D (`defineCube`, `defineStack({ analyticsCubes })`, the showcase cube) — pre-existing drift, agreed with the dev's flag, not this PR's.

**B. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (AI-facing, published via `npx skills add`) — the rewritten sentences, verdict RIGHT.**
- `:70` the escalate cell drops "or any custom-SQL metric" — right: a cube member admits no expression, so no layer offers a custom-SQL metric; the one in the tree (`done_rate`) is now a dataset measure-filter count plus a derived ratio (`chart-gallery.dataset.ts:34-40`).
- `:78-80` "escalate to a stored field on the object (a `summary` rollup, or a field holding the computed value or bucket) or app code, not to a Cube: a cube member's `sql` is a column reference" — right on each limb. `summary` is a live stored field: `field.zod.ts:1669-1697` (`summaryOperations` with `function` count/sum/min/max/avg and a `filter`), recomputed by the engine (`objectql/src/engine.ts:10431-10774`, `summary-aggregate.ts`, `summary-backfill.ts`), a numeric column in SQL (`sql-driver.ts:19438`). Is a Cube still a valid escalation for ANY need in the right column? No: cube joins are declared by target only with the ON clause derived from the FK on the base object (`showcase.cube.ts:67-86`, `analytics.zod.ts:428-502`), so a cube reaches the same to-one grain a dataset `include` reaches — no grain-changing or to-many join; a dimension `sql` is a column, so no CASE bucket or bin; `AggregationMetricType` has no list aggregation; the analytics query schema has no `having`, window or union (grep over `api/analytics.zod.ts` and `data/analytics.zod.ts`); scalar math and aggregate-of-aggregate are expressions. "explicit joins" in the old text was already false before this PR (joins derived since #18612). For HAVING / window / union the honest escalation left is "app code", which the sentence names.
- Dropped "formula field" (declared beyond the retirement) — right, the dev's evidence holds: `sql-driver.ts:19561-19562` "Virtual — no column"; `aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts` (spec) refuses `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` over `formula` on the storage ground; `dataset-compiler.ts:355-357` and `:389` / `:713` enforce it; `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:407-411` already says "Denormalise onto a stored field". A formula field can carry no analytics need (it cannot be aggregated or grouped in SQL), so naming it as an escalation was false text and dropping it is a correction, not scope creep.
- Unchanged sentences in the same Level A section (`:59-100`): `:75-77` (dataset: no raw SQL, no hand-authored joins, no window/having) true; `:85-88` (to-many rollup → stored rollup field) true and now consistent with the iron rule; `:91-94` (CASE / bins / computed dimensions → not a dataset) true, names no target; `:95-100` true. The Analytics Cubes section `:433-468` uses identifiers and `'*'` only; Rule 1 is the cube-level `sql`. Nothing in the file is left false.
- File readings in the PR body: 468 lines before and after (verified by `wc -l` on both blobs); 24842 → 24843 bytes; the ratchet measures ceil(bytes/4) = 6211 both sides against the 6252 ceiling (`check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:523`); `skills/**/SKILL.md` sum 4395 lines both sides (verified). All right.

**C. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/dashboards.json` item `dashboards.cube-query` — verdict RIGHT.**
- Lifecycle "Change" obeyed: fields edited, `revision` 2 → 3, a `history` entry appended with what and why; `revision` equals the last history entry's, the rule the validator's header names (`check-platform-checklist.mjs:28-30`).
- Every clause names only what the showcase declares at the head: measures `count` / `total_estimate_hours` / `avg_estimate_hours` and dimensions `status` / `priority` / `due_date` / `assignee` (`showcase.cube.ts:22-66`); registered as `analyticsCubes` (`coverage.ts:198-200`). The history entry's "declared on the showcase_task_metrics dataset ... as a filtered count over a count" is right (`chart-gallery.dataset.ts:34-40`); "steps, reconciliation clauses and the four dimensions unchanged" is right against the diff. No other `done_rate` remains anywhere under `docs/qa/platform-checklist`. The unchanged source anchor `showcase.cube.ts#showcase_project` and the `analytics.ts #2852` line citation are pre-existing and untouched.
- The validator itself is out of per-PR CI; the dev's exit 1 on `identity-auth.json` `twoFactor` reproduces on `main` and is not this diff's (the file list proves this PR touches neither that area file nor `plugin-auth`).

**D. PR body, as text the maintainer acts on.** "Part of #20943", "Clause-②: no", three files, no package source, "No changeset: none of the three paths ships in a package's files[]" (verified: no `package.json` under `packages/` / `examples/` / `apps/` lists a `files[]` entry naming `skills` or `docs`) — all right. The `## 维护者速读(草稿)` section: 改了什么 / 为什么改 / 风险与代价 / 你要做的 — each sentence true at the head ("按旧教法写出的 cube，解析时就会被拒" is exactly the parse refusal; "回滚就是 revert 这一个提交" — the branch holds one commit). One sentence of the body is over-broad, and it is the blocking finding:

**E. BLOCKING — the same published skill still teaches the retired escalation, outside the three files.**
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json:18` (eval 2, `expected_output`): "Escalates to a hand-authored Cube (raw SQL) or a stored/materialized rolling field" — false at the head (a cube member's `sql` is a column reference; a Cube cannot carry a window or rolling calculation), and the direct opposite of the rule this PR writes at `dashboards.md:78-80` ("not to a Cube"). The evals README says these fixtures score whether an AI applies the skill's rules, so this is text a grader acts on: an answer that follows the rewritten rule is now graded against an expected answer that endorses the retired shape.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md:9-10`: "when it must escalate to a Cube or a stored rollup field" — the same false escalation, in the fixture index.
- Both are `skills/objectstack-ui/**` (governed Tier H, shipped by `npx skills add`), both were made false by #20998, and this PR is the Tier H carrier the ruling names for `skills/**`; the dev contract the dev itself cites (`5922668750` Q3) says published text the change makes false is fixed in the same round. The PR body's "the iron rule no longer escalates to a hand-authored Cube with raw SQL" is therefore true of `rules/dashboards.md` and false of the skill as published.
- The fix is two sentences, and the token ratchet constrains it: `analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` sits exactly at its ceiling (4406 bytes = 1102 tokens of 1102, zero headroom) and `evals/README.md` at 287 of 289. Rewrite eval 2's expected output to escalate to a stored or materialized rolling field or app code and NOT to a Cube (shorter than the current text, so the ceiling holds; `must_contain: ["window","Cube"]` still passes on an answer that says "not a Cube", or drop "Cube" from it), and re-spell README `:9-10` to "when it must escalate to a stored rollup field or app code" (shorter). No other file under `skills/` or `content/docs/` teaches a cube member expression (grep over `custom-SQL`, `custom SQL`, `CASE WHEN`, `raw SQL`, `SQL expression` at the head; the generated `references/data/analytics.mdx` already carries the new describe text).

### ② Semver level

Right. The diff publishes nothing from any package: `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**` and `docs/qa/**` are in no released package's `files[]` (measured above; AGENTS.md rule 3 reserves `skip-changeset` for exactly this case), `skills/` reach consumers from GitHub, not npm. `Clause-②: no` and the `skip-changeset` label (present on the PR, applied by the seat in `5924874583`) are right; `Check Changeset` is `skipped` on the head accordingly. No changeset is owed. The BREAKING changeset for the retirement itself landed with #20998, where it belongs.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `5924841117` open question Q1 (speed-read section and package reading): seat answered A; verified both are now in the body (`## 维护者速读(草稿)` present; "every `skills/**/SKILL.md` together is 4395 lines" verified).
- Dev `5924841117` declared beyond-scope item ("formula field" dropped): judged in ①B — right, keep.
- Dev `5924841117` out-of-scope finding (ADR-0021 D-A row and D1 sketch say the Cube DSL is absorbed while `analytics_cube` is still authored): agreed — decision-time text, pre-existing, not made false by this retirement; no action in this PR; whether to file an ADR-0021 revision is the seat's call, not blocking.
- Dev `5924841117` seat actions: `skip-changeset` — applied, verified; speed-read section — inserted, verified. "Check Changeset is expected to go red" — overtaken: it is `skipped` on the head.
- Dev `5924841117` "`check:platform-checklist` exit 1 on `twoFactor`": `main`'s, reproduced by the dev on a detached `origin/main`; this diff touches neither the area file nor `plugin-auth`. Not this PR's.
- Carried from `5922668750` / `5922695050` (the code half): the `dashboards.md` `:70` / `:78` finding and the checklist `done_rate` finding — both delivered here (①B, ①C). The `CubeSchema.sql` description ("Base SQL statement or Table Name") stays outside ruling D (members only) — the ADR note's "members" wording keeps it so; not this PR's. The `check:i18n-coverage` derivation gap (`5922922632`) is not reachable from a diff with no `examples/` path.
- Escalated by this review (①E): the skill's eval fixture and evals README still name a raw-SQL Cube as an escalation. Owner: this PR (Tier H `skills/**` carrier). Not a seat decision — it is a false sentence with a mechanical fix.
- Observation, not this PR's text and not filed: `CUBE_MEMBER_SQL_RETIRED` (`analytics.zod.ts:242`) says the expression "was retired in @objectstack/spec 17" while `packages/spec` is at 17.5.0 and the retirement is a BREAKING major-18 D3 entry per #20998's own body; the ADR note repeats no version, so nothing in this diff inherits it. For the spec seat.

Check-runs on `68593d46d8`, fetched 2026-10-01T05:06Z, 46 runs deduped by name to 31 keeping the newest `started_at`: 21 `success`, 10 `skipped`, 0 failure, 0 in progress. Successes include `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint & Repo Gates` (the ADR link and symbol-anchor gates, the skills ratchets), `Check Documentation Links`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `Test Core` and its six shards, the four `Type Check` jobs and `TypeScript Type Check`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`. Skipped: `Auto Label`, `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Console Pin Gate`, the dogfood shard matrix, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, `Temporal Conformance`. None still running. The gates are green; the verdict below is on ①E alone.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20943-adr0021-note`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Adopted and posted by `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`) · 2026-10-01T05:09Z · rendered by the seat's at-tier review subagent on this head. The seat read its served tier family from the subagent transcript before posting.
- **FAIL adopted, on ①E alone.** The same published skill still names a raw-SQL Cube as an escalation, in `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` (eval 2's expected output) and `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/README.md`. This PR is the `skills/**` carrier, so both sentences are fixed here.
- **Cut round:** the dev is resumed for exactly those two sentences. Each is re-spelled shorter, because the eval file sits at its token ceiling. No other file changes. A delta review on the new head follows.
- **The observation on `CUBE_MEMBER_SQL_RETIRED` ("retired in @objectstack/spec 17"):** read, no action. The house spelling for a retirement shipped on the 17.x line is the major alone: "removed in @objectstack/spec 17" appears 112 times in `packages/spec/src`.
- `needs:contract-review` stays on the PR and #20943 until the new head passes.
